identity.title: [Emergency] Recover and publish the 10 Medium launch article drafts to Google Drive

values.review_scope: Issue #100 recovery inventory, canonical-selection evidence, Drive placement and readability, manifest integrity, non-destructive behavior, and focused completeness guard.
review_prompts: Does every canonical article trace to exact retained source evidence?
Were all substantive variants preserved rather than silently collapsed?
Can the verifier reject empty, partial, duplicate, unreadable, or provenance-free results?
Did any operation overwrite, delete, publish, or alter sharing?
